title: Potential duality preserves bounded constructibility
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $r\geq1$, and $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$. Let $X$ be a Noetherian excellent scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-exc-excellent-ring], equipped with a dimension function $\delta$, and let $K$ be a pinned potential dualizing complex [def-per-potential-dualizing-complex]. Then the functor $D_K=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(-,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] sends every $M\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ to an object of $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. This asserts preservation of bounded constructibility only; invertibility of the biduality morphism is not assumed.

proof.text: This is exactly [lem-per-potential-dual-constructible-preservation], whose statement has the same data and hypotheses: a prime $\ell$, $r\geq1$, $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$, a Noetherian excellent scheme $X$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, a dimension function $\delta$ and a pinned potential dualizing complex $K$ for $(X,\delta,\Lambda)$ in the sense of [def-per-potential-dualizing-complex]. Its conclusion is that $D_KM=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(M,K)$ lies in $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ for every $M\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$, with the same derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and the same bounded constructible category [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Neither statement assumes invertibility of a biduality morphism. Hence the assertion of the item is that statement verbatim up to wording.

proof_origin.place: Expose XVII, Proposition 6.2.3.1, pp. 295-296 (proved in the DAG as lem-per-potential-dual-constructible-preservation)

The item statement matches 6.2.3.1 for Lambda=Z/ell^r (Noetherian excellent, ell invertible, delta, pinned potential complex, no biduality) and is unchanged. There are no new nodes and no SGA source. Duplicate: lem-per-potential-dual-constructible-preservation (created by Q10, split by NL 1f722a45, reviewed with result pass) has the same statement, hypothesis by hypothesis. The worker reported this but delivered a second, independent proof. Fix: the item's proof is now a single elementary step citing that node (plus the three definition nodes it names); proof_deps match, tool_uses are empty, the split_report summary was rewritten, and the statement is unchanged. Its closure (13154 nodes) does not contain the item, so there is no cycle, and both nodes are in unit sk-p-dl-a1-perverse. The 12 delivered steps were sound: (1) the uniqueness node gives K in D^b_c; (2) ctf-hom-locally-constant with A=F_ell, using a Galois partition from the simultaneous-partition node; (3) reduction via the universal-homeomorphism equivalence and finite-pullback with trdeg 0; (4) the Noetherian induction is quantified over all potential complexes, with the dense open U built explicitly; (5) finite-pullback for i and j. Its i^! (right adjoint of Rf_! = i_*) equals the supported-kernel Ri^! of the localization node only by uniqueness of right adjoints of the exact i_*, transporting the pinnings; this is implicit but elementary, and NL makes the same identification. (6) The localization triangle is used with bounded M[0] and bounded-below K; (7) i_* constructibility via the comparison node and finite stalks; (8) Gabber finiteness, sheaf by sheaf, with finitely many truncations; (9) closure under triangles; (10) hom-coefficient-restriction with m=1 and coinduction with s=1, which needs K in D^+ (true since K is bounded); (11) the ell-adic filtration descending from ell^r M=0; (12) truncation devissage. Edge cases checked: empty X, M=0, rank 0, r=1, nonreduced X, Z empty. Batch 5: in a walk from the two targets that stops at nt-assume-*, sk-thm-trace-transport and the trf/pod chapters, the closure is the same with or without the item's proof (15230 nodes, difference empty), and each flagged citation is already in it without the item. The flags reach only generic nodes: pod-etale-stalk-tensor-scalar (stalk tensor), trf-local-dimension-formula (commutative algebra), trf-ambient-diagonal-purity-base-change (inside the base proof of finite-pullback, not a trace-formula step), trf-excellent-scheme-affine-cover and trf-ind-etale-strict-local-invariance. None is a step of the trace formula or of Poincare duality, so all are accepted. After the fix the item cites only the preservation node, whose four flags NL had already accepted.
